symbols.description: A molecule that contains biological instructions and is passed from adult organisms to offspring during reproduction.
symbols.name: Deoxyribonucleic acid

symbols.description: Instructions contained in DNA that make each species unique and can be used to make proteins and support other biological processes.
symbols.name: biological instructions

symbols.description: A biological grouping that DNA helps make unique.
symbols.name: species

symbols.description: An organism that can pass DNA to offspring during reproduction.
symbols.name: adult organism

symbols.description: Organisms that receive DNA from adult organisms during reproduction.
symbols.name: offspring

symbols.description: An organism whose DNA is found inside a nucleus.
symbols.name: eukaryote

symbols.description: A small biological unit in which DNA molecules and, in some organisms, mitochondria are found.
symbols.name: cell

symbols.description: A special area of a cell where DNA is found in eukaryotes.
symbols.name: nucleus

symbols.description: A molecule of DNA that is tightly packaged in a cell because cells contain many DNA molecules.
symbols.name: DNA molecule

symbols.description: The tightly packaged form of a DNA molecule; DNA is in this compact form during cell division.
symbols.name: chromosome

symbols.description: A process during which DNA unwinds so it can be copied.
symbols.name: DNA replication

symbols.description: A cycle during which DNA can unwind at times other than DNA replication so its instructions can be used.
symbols.name: cell cycle

symbols.description: A product that can be made using instructions in DNA.
symbols.name: protein

symbols.description: A process during which DNA is in compact chromosome form to enable transfer to new cells.
symbols.name: cell division

symbols.description: DNA found in the nucleus of a cell.
symbols.name: nuclear DNA

symbols.description: An organism's complete set of nuclear DNA; also described as a complete DNA instruction book.
symbols.name: genome

symbols.description: A cell structure containing a small amount of DNA in humans and other complex organisms and generating energy needed for the cell to function properly.
symbols.name: mitochondrion

symbols.description: Energy generated by mitochondria that the cell needs to function properly.
symbols.name: energy

symbols.description: An organism that has a small amount of DNA in mitochondria in addition to DNA in the nucleus.
symbols.name: complex organism

symbols.description: A form of reproduction in which organisms inherit half of their nuclear DNA from the male parent and half from the female parent.
symbols.name: sexual reproduction

symbols.description: A parent from which an organism inherits half of its nuclear DNA during sexual reproduction.
symbols.name: male parent

symbols.description: A parent from which an organism inherits half of its nuclear DNA and all of its mitochondrial DNA during sexual reproduction.
symbols.name: female parent

symbols.description: DNA located in mitochondria and inherited entirely from the female parent.
symbols.name: mitochondrial DNA

symbols.description: A cell that keeps its mitochondria during fertilization.
symbols.name: egg cell

symbols.description: A cell that does not keep its mitochondria during fertilization.
symbols.name: sperm cell

symbols.description: A process during which only egg cells, and not sperm cells, keep their mitochondria.
symbols.name: fertilization

symbols.description: A chemical building block of DNA made of a phosphate group, a sugar group, and one of four types of nitrogen bases.
symbols.name: nucleotide

symbols.description: One of the three parts of a nucleotide; phosphate groups alternate with sugar groups in a DNA strand.
symbols.name: phosphate group

symbols.description: One of the three parts of a nucleotide; sugar groups alternate with phosphate groups in a DNA strand.
symbols.name: sugar group

symbols.description: One of four types of chemical building blocks found in DNA nucleotides.
symbols.name: nitrogen base

symbols.description: A strand formed when nucleotides are linked into chains, with phosphate and sugar groups alternating.
symbols.name: DNA strand

symbols.description: A type of nitrogen base found in nucleotides.
symbols.name: adenine

symbols.description: A type of nitrogen base found in nucleotides.
symbols.name: thymine

symbols.description: A type of nitrogen base found in nucleotides.
symbols.name: guanine

symbols.description: A type of nitrogen base found in nucleotides.
symbols.name: cytosine

symbols.description: The order of nitrogen bases in a DNA strand, which determines the biological instructions contained in the strand.
symbols.name: base sequence

symbols.description: A unit included in the approximately 20,000 genes on a human genome's 23 pairs of chromosomes.
symbols.name: gene

symbols.description: An organism whose complete nuclear DNA instruction book contains about 3 billion bases and about 20,000 genes on 23 pairs of chromosomes.
symbols.name: human

relationships.statement: Biological instructions are contained in Deoxyribonucleic acid.
Deoxyribonucleic acid is passed from adult organisms to their offspring during reproduction.
In eukaryotes, DNA is found inside the nucleus.
The nucleus is a special area of the cell.
The compact chromosome form of DNA during cell division enables transfer to new cells.
Nuclear DNA is DNA found in the nucleus.
An organism's genome is its complete set of nuclear DNA.
Mitochondrial DNA is DNA located in mitochondria.
Mitochondrial DNA is located in mitochondria.
Mitochondria are cell structures.
Mitochondria generate the energy the cell needs to function properly.
Humans are complex organisms.
Instructions in DNA can be used to make proteins.
Nucleotides are linked into chains to form a strand of DNA.
A phosphate group is one of the three parts of a nucleotide.
A sugar group is one of the three parts of a nucleotide.
A nitrogen base is one of the three parts of a nucleotide.
Adenine is one of the four types of nitrogen bases found in nucleotides.
Thymine is one of the four types of nitrogen bases found in nucleotides.
Guanine is one of the four types of nitrogen bases found in nucleotides.
Cytosine is one of the four types of nitrogen bases found in nucleotides.
The order or sequence of bases determines the biological instructions contained in a strand of DNA.

transfer_events.statement: During sexual reproduction, nuclear DNA is inherited by offspring from the male parent.
During sexual reproduction, nuclear DNA is inherited by offspring from the female parent.
During sexual reproduction, mitochondrial DNA is inherited by offspring from the female parent.
